body.statement: Uniformly over compact subsets of \(\mathfrak R_{\varepsilon}\), under independent multinomial sampling and \(n/n_m\to\lambda\in(0,\infty)\) when margins are estimated, the deterministic selector \(\widehat\chi_n\) chooses an incident first-order-compatible rigid chart and \(\widehat\gamma_n=1\) with probability tending to one. On these certified separated rigid charts, \(\widehat\Omega_n\xrightarrow{P}\Omega_{\zeta}\), \(\sqrt n(\widehat\tau_n-\tau)\Rightarrow N(0,V_{\tau})\), and \(\widehat V_n\xrightarrow{P}V_{\tau}\). Because \(\lambda_{\min}(V_{\tau})\ge\varepsilon\), scalar contrasts and the elliptical branch of \(W_n\) have asymptotic coverage \(1-\alpha\). If no chart is certified, the total procedure returns \(\widehat\chi_n=\bot\), \(\widehat\tau_n=(0,0)\), \(\widehat V_n=I_2\), and \(W_n=[0,1]^2\), with no covariance-consistency or Wald-coverage assertion for that fallback branch.
body.justification: The chart rule, covariance formula, and nonsingularity margin make regular-stratum Wald inference operational and falsifiable.
body.gap: The anchor and earlier response-type estimators establish regular-case normality only for their inverse formulas, not for deterministically selected rational and simple algebraic rigid charts.
body.consumer: Separated empirical tables obtain reproducible standard errors and Wald regions on every first-order-compatible atlas chart.

obligation.what_is_open: Unconditional correctness of the deterministic chart selector for the claimed atlas on every separated rigid stratum.
obligation.obstruction: The multinomial delta-method calculation closes once the incident atlas is locally exhaustive. Without the mixed-support exhaustion theorem, an omitted nearby component can invalidate chart certification and the exclusion of incompatible charts.
obligation.attempted: Completed the chart-distance, slack-continuity, common-Jacobian Taylor, sandwich-consistency, positive-definiteness, Wald, and fallback calculations conditional on local atlas exhaustiveness.
obligation.partial_result:
Conditional on local exhaustiveness of the certified finite atlas, independent multinomial sampling and proportional independent margin sampling give
\[
\sqrt n(\widehat\zeta_n-\zeta)\Rightarrow N(0,\Omega_{\zeta}),
\qquad
\widehat\Omega_n\xrightarrow{P}\Omega_{\zeta}.
\]
For every incident chart,
\[
d_{\chi}(\widehat\zeta_n)\le \lVert\widehat\zeta_n-\zeta\rVert_2=O_P(n^{-1/2})=o_P(t_n),
\]
and continuity of \(\eta_{\chi}\), together with \(\eta_{\chi}(\zeta)\ge\varepsilon\), makes its slack test pass with probability tending to one. Positive distance from incompatible chart closures excludes those charts. The common incident value and Jacobian then imply
\[
\sqrt n(\widehat\tau_n-\tau)
=J_{\chi}(\zeta)\sqrt n(\widehat\zeta_n-\zeta)+o_P(1),
\]
uniformly on compact subsets of the separated stratum. Continuity of the sandwich map and \(\lambda_{\min}(V_{\tau})\ge\varepsilon\) give covariance consistency, eventual certification, and ordinary Wald coverage. The fallback identities follow directly from their definitions. This proves the asymptotic calculation conditional on atlas exhaustiveness but cannot establish selector correctness if a mixed-support chart is missing.
